entities.name: Codex Tischendorfianus III
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Codex Tischendorfianus III – designated by siglum Λ or 039, ε 77 – is a Greek uncial manuscript of the Gospels on parchment. Palaeographically it has been assigned to the 9th or 10th century.
